children: Exxonmobil Holdings Corporation (NYSE:XOM) posted strong Q2 cash flow and shareholder returns while advancing carbon-capture and Rose CCS projects, eyeing a return to Venezuela’s Petromonagas amid complex Rosneft-linked stakes, and managing a Joliet outage as shares rally on tight oil markets.
Previous Week Recap
Exxonmobil Holdings Corporation Operating Cash Flow Sale
: ExxonMobil (XOM) Q2 operating cash flow $23.6B; free cash flow $17.2B. Returned $9.4B to shareholders via dividends and buybacks, about 54.7% of quarterly FCF.
ExxonMobil Near Deal To Rejoin Petromonagas
: ExxonMobil (XOM) is close to a preliminary deal to rejoin Venezuela’s Petromonagas project in the Orinoco Belt, negotiating an MoU with PDVSA on exploration and field access amid ongoing talks.
ExxonMobil Joliet Power Outage Restored
: ExxonMobil (XOM) Joliet refinery had a power outage Sept 13; power restored ~4 hours later. Company cites ComEd lines as likely cause. Restart and full production expected to take several days.
ExxonMobil Rose Carbon-Capture Approved
: ExxonMobil (XOM) won Texas approval (2-1) to advance its Rose carbon-capture project, clearing a regulatory hurdle for the large-scale emissions-reduction development.
ExxonMobil, Pioneer Note Repurchase
: ExxonMobil (XOM) via a subsidiary and Pioneer repurchased $2.1B of Pioneer 1.900% 2030 and 2.150% 2031 notes; offers expired Sept 14, 2026, settlement expected Sept 16, 2026.
Woods: Refining Shortfall Critique Tax
: ExxonMobil (XOM) CEO Darren Woods said July Q2 call: refining capacity shortfall vs. demand is the worst since COVID-19 and criticized a proposed downstream windfall tax.
Rosneft Stakes May Affect Deal
: Russian-linked stakes via Rosneft and Roszarubezhneft in Petromonagas may affect any deal involving ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation (XOM).
Carbon Capture At Nucor Plant
: ExxonMobil (XOM) started carbon capture operations at Nucor’s Louisiana DRI plant, a project that can sequester up to 800,000 metric tons of CO2 a year.
XOM Up Amid High Brent
: XOM up ~1.5% to $167.42 as Brent >$105/bbl; traders cite tighter global supply and stronger crude margins despite a refinery outage.
ExxonMobil (XOM) rose ~1% Monday; price sits above key moving averages and MACD turned positive, signaling a constructive near-term technical trend for traders.
